watch.summary: The streamer passionately celebrates 100 Thieves' 2-0 victory in an esports match, loudly proclaiming himself as one of the loyal fans the caster is describing.

Creator points to his head smugly while listening to the caster talk about true believers.
Creator shouts and flexes, loudly declaring 'I'm that fan, baby!'
